tagline: Five miles of freeway that let the old crossroads breathe.
intro: This byway is a freeway. West of Exton the US 30 freeway crosses over the Lincoln Highway, meets it at an interchange and takes the name Exton Bypass. From there it runs northeast beside Amtrak's Keystone Corridor to the US 202 interchange, where the freeway ends and US 30 goes back to being the Lincoln Highway.

It was slow in coming. Environmental concerns and money kept construction from starting until 1993, and the road opened in December 1995, taking through traffic away from the old crossing of US 30 and PA 100 in Exton, the source of major congestion. The legislature made it a scenic byway the next July.

moments.title: Exton
moments.text: A theory holds that the town is named for the X on the map where the Lancaster Road met the road to Pottstown, though more likely it borrowed the name of an English Exton.

moments.title: American Helicopter Museum
moments.text: In West Chester, south of the eastern end, a museum opened in October 1996 collects more than 40 autogyros, convertiplanes and helicopters, early models among them.
